notes: *of good courage* is taken whole as אָמֵץ's rendering and headed on *courage* (rule 44); the same division is used at JOS.1.9 and JOS.1.18.
*shalt cause ... to inherit* heads on the second verb carrying the lexeme (rule 44), discontinuous around the object under rule 25.
The infinitive's לְ takes the written *to* (rule 52) while the dative לְ of *give them* is `unrepresented` (rule 40); both are correct against the English.
